vector query
Query vectors

Search a vector collection.

Runs vector search through the engine planner and returns the best matches with scores and optional metadata.

Search responses return a bounded list of matches ordered by the engine. They are not cursor pages unless a later command explicitly advertises pagination.

Facts:
  ID: vector.query
  Docs: /docs/vector/query
  Access: read
  Commit: none
  Pagination: bounded
  Batch: none
  Input: Command::VectorQuery
  Outputs: Output::VectorMatches
  Response: SearchResult<VectorMatch>
  Wire: stable

Errors:
  failed_precondition.engine.runtime_closed
  not_found.engine.branch
  invalid_argument.engine.product_space
  invalid_argument.engine.vector_collection
  invalid_argument.engine.vector_key
  not_found.executor.vector_collection
  invalid_argument.engine.vector_filter
  invalid_argument.executor.vector_limit
